confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from crowd-sourced and undated regional price guides plus a few 2026 reviews, converted at about 1.15 USD per EUR (the rate implied by the source conversions, not an independent FX check). Restaurant and beer anchors are moderate confidence; the cocktail anchor is weaker and was set using the local cocktail-to-beer relationship, and the wine glass anchor was set against the beer anchor. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a Spanish coastal city in peak July season, not checked against live listings or current booking pages. The FX observation is the RBA exchange rates page's reported 16 October 2026 value as surfaced by search; the F11.1 data file itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treated as a lower-cost Andalusian coastal city, in line with regional guides that group Cádiz with Alicante and Granada. Food and drink use Andalusian and Spanish bar and menu del día ranges, and accommodation is a holistic estimate from comparable Spanish mid-sized coastal cities in summer.
